next_steps: Experiment 2 (MAE=109.99, RMSE=154.80) substantially outperformed Experiment 1 (MAE=151.87), confirming that sufficient model capacity (d_model=128, 3 layers) and a higher learning rate (5e-4 vs 1e-4) are both essential for this architecture. However, all Transformer configurations significantly underperform LSTM and TCN, suggesting the model's 406,017 parameters cause overfitting relative to the per-area training set size. Experiment 3 will test higher dropout (0.2) to assess whether regularisation can close the performance gap, but Experiment 2 is the current best TF config.
